The output features of each atom of the molecule encoder and the output features of each residue of the protein encoder are projected to the feature space of BioMedGPT-LM-7B with independent modality adaptors composed of a fully-connected layer.

Following mPLUG-owl [Ye et al., 2023], we freeze the parameters of BioMedGPT-LM and optimize the parameters of the molecule encoder, protein encoder, and modality adaptors to save the computational cost and avoid catastrophic forgetting.
